mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ods_game_record_one_net ogron INNER JOIN dim_user_info dui on (ogron.user_id = dui.user_id) WHERE ogron.dates = #{dates}

SELECT ogron.id, ogron.dates, dui.user_id, dui.last_version `version`, dui.pkg, dui.country, ogron.game_id, ogon.name, ogon.`type`, ogron.played_time, ogron.game_result, ogron.reward_source, ogron.expend_account_type, ogron.expend, ogron.reward_account_type, ogron.reward FROM ods_game_record_one_net ogron INNER JOIN dim_user_info dui on (ogron.user_id = dui.user_id) LEFT JOIN ods_game_one_net ogon on (ogon.id = ogron.game_id) WHERE ogron.dates = #{dates} limit #{startRows}, #{rows}
